# sfcompute_pool (Resource)

Manages an SF Compute pool (created with `POST /v2/pools`, updated in place with `PATCH /v2/pools/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A pool holds purchased compute time; a new pool is empty and free.
resource "sfcompute_pool" "train" {
  name = "train"
  tags = {
    team = "ml"
  }
  # workspace defaults to the provider's workspace.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Unique name for this pool.
- `tags` (Map of String) Optional metadata tags for this pool.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace to create this pool in. If omitted, the provider's `workspace` is used.

### Read-Only

- `_preview_deployments` (Attributes List) Active deployments targeting this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--_preview_deployments))
- `_preview_procurements` (Attributes List) Active procurements targeting this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--_preview_procurements))
- `allocation_schedule` (Attributes) Allocation schedule of this pool. Add to the schedule by placing buy orders into this pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_schedule))
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `id` (String) A resource path like 'sfc:pool:acme:prod:my-pool' _or_ an ID. Resource paths are human-readable but not stable - they change when resources are renamed or moved. IDs are stable and permanent.
- `resource_path` (String) A resource path for a pool resource. Format: sfc:pool:<account>:<workspace>:<name>.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Nested Schema for `_preview_procurements`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--allocation_schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_schedule`

Read-Only:

- `by_sku` (Map of List of Object) Allocation schedule keyed by SKU id. Only includes current and future schedule.
- `total` (Attributes List) Combined allocation schedule across all SKUs. Only includes current and future schedule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--allocation_schedule--total))

<a id="nestedatt--allocation_schedule--total"></a>
### Nested Schema for `allocation_schedule.total`

Read-Only:

- `end_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.
- `node_count` (Number)
- `start_at` (Number) Unix timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sfcompute_pool.train pool_k3RnX9vLm7Qp2Yw5Jd8F
```
